Name: slO's vanilla Small Farmhouse
Author: slpOff
Description:
[heading]Description[/heading]
[b]Small Farmhouse[/b] replaces the farmhouse interiors with compact layouts for a cozy, space-saving home. Its companion mod, [b]Farmhouse Helper[/b], adapts upgrades and renovations to fit the smaller rooms.
[heading]Installation instructions[/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Install Content Patcher.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip Extremely Small Farmhouse.[/*]
[*]Place both the [CP] Small Farmhouse and FarmhouseHelper folders in your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Main features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Replaces farmhouse interiors and renovation maps with compact layouts.[/*]
[*]Adjusts furniture placement as your farmhouse is upgraded.[/*]
[*]Reduces farmhouse upgrade costs to one-fifth of their usual amount.[/*]
[*]Lets you add or remove a kitchen through Robin’s renovation menu and choose where to place it.[/*]
[*]Lets you choose where to place a crib when adding one through Robin’s renovation menu.[/*]
[*]Supports moving the crib with the optional [b]Let’s Move It[/b] mod.[/*]
[/list][heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.1.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*][b]Content Patcher 2.8.0 or later[/b][/*]
[*]Both included mod folders: [b][CP] Small Farmhouse[/b] and [b]Farmhouse Helper[/b][/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Farmhouse Helper
Manifest.Description: SMAPI companion for Extremely Small Farmhouse.
